First stable release of the LexVibe MCP server.

## Highlights

- **Full Article 5 questionnaire in `check_ai_act`**: the EU AI Act risk classification now walks through every prohibited-practice category of art. 5 (subliminal/manipulative techniques, exploitation of vulnerabilities, social scoring, predictive policing, facial recognition scraping, emotion recognition at work/school, biometric categorisation, real-time remote biometric identification) instead of a reduced subset.
- **Every tool parameter described**: all input parameters across the 10 tools now carry explicit descriptions, so MCP clients (Claude, Cursor…) can fill them correctly without guessing.
- **`glama.json`** added for the Glama MCP server directory.

## Verification

- `npm run build` (strict TypeScript) clean.
- `node scripts/smoke.mjs`: stdio boot, initialize + tools/list, 10 tools announced, minimum contract honoured.
